/speckit.constitution Create principles focused on code file #file:minimal-api-scaffolding.prompt.md 


/speckit.specify Build an API using the file #file:santa_bounded_contexts_consolidated.md 

/speckit.plan The application uses Minimal API with an external library to manage the CQRS+ES pattern. The library name is Muflone and you can find a complete documentation in #muflone-core.prompt.md. You have to create architectural tests also, following the instructions that you can find in #architecture-tests.prompt.md. These tests aim to guarantee that each module is isolate from the other ones.
